description: Columnar Yelp JSON codec: 132-bit packed ids, sorted dictionaries (zstd-1), fused-separator piece tables for attributes/categories/hours, nibble coordinates, varint review counts; per-row index blob is LZ4_HC compressed (fast single-pass decode). Encoder verifies byte-exact reconstruction before emitting the archive.
name: yelp-columnar-lz4row
